0022600035.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-11, 15th in the East, eight straight losses) visit the Orlando Magic (4-7, 10th in the East, winners of their last two), with the Bucks still searching for their first road win after an 0-5 start away from home. Milwaukee is missing Myles Turner (out, rest), and Ryan Rollins is day-to-day with a head injury and a game-time decision, while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jamal Cain, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, Paolo Banchero and Tristan da Silva. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bucks lost 1-2 to Orlando in the 2025-26 season series, including a 130-91 loss in Milwaukee on March 8.
